_doc: Per picture (the folder name under public/media/photograph or routes): how its cutout is made. mode: vision (Apple's foreground mask, the default), semantic (SegFormer ADE20K labels what each region is: everything that is not the sky, or `exclude`/`classes`; `boost` classes it under-labels; `crop`), polygon (a hand-drawn outline of the subject, shares of the picture), sky (older: sky grown by colour), none. All of them end in alpha matting at the edge. band: the unknown strip round the edge, px. occlude: the share of the word's height the subject hides (default 0.35). percentile: which of the subject's columns the top edge is read at (the tallest N% start above it; default 15). none: no cutout for this picture (the poster shows the photograph flat): kept for the pictures where no cut was clean enough. rod: a straight pole and its flag cut by geometry (axis, half, flag). placeOnly: no cutout is drawn, the subject's edge only places the photograph (a skyline stays under the word at any card width). blend: the cutout is dimmed and faded as the photograph is.
